about: Cases where KiCad's reference disagrees with the maker's datasheet, checked by hand against the datasheet text. A field listed here that fails against KiCad is scored as right (the report lists it as a reference erratum) when ours is what the datasheet says. A number under "ours" (e.g. the pitch) must match ours, or none of the case's errata apply: the other fields (pads, pin 1, courtyard) are excused only when we built the datasheet's package. "reference": {"footprint": <a footprint in the set's references>} scores the case against that KiCad footprint instead, when KiCad's own reference is another variant of the package.

symbol_names.why: Diodes AH1806 datasheet (AH1806.pdf) p1 pinout and p2 pin table: SC59 (the -W package, p5) pin 1 VDD, pin 2 GND, pin 3 OUTPUT. KiCad's Sensor_Magnetic:AH1806-W has 2 OUTPUT, 3 GND.

reference.why: NXP PCA9557.pdf Rev. 7 p2 ordering table: PCA9557BS is HVQFN16 SOT629-1; p20 Fig 25 SOT629-1: body 4 x 4 x 0.85 mm, e 0.65, Dh/Eh 1.95-2.25, b 0.23-0.38; p26 Fig 29 footprint: pitch 0.65, pad 0.30 x 1.10, solder land 2.0 x 2.0. KiCad's reference HVQFN-16-1EP_3x3mm_P0.5mm_EP1.5x1.5mm is the 3 x 3 mm 0.5 mm package, another variant. Scored against KiCad's 4 x 4 mm 0.65 mm VQFN-16 with a 2.1 mm exposed pad instead (Texas RGV0016A, already in the set's references; Dh/Eh nom 2.1 like SOT629-1), so pad 1, pitch, pads and courtyard are all checked; it replaced an erratum that excused those fields whenever the pitch was 0.65.

symbol_names.why: Microchip/Atmel doc0014.pdf (AT27C256R) p2 pin table 'O0 - O7 Outputs' and the 28-lead PDIP diagram; the datasheet has no D0 or Q0. KiCad's Memory_EPROM:27C256 names them D0-D7.

courtyard.why: doc0014.pdf p11 28P6 PDIP: D 36.703-37.338 mm, E1 13.462-13.970 mm (our body); KiCad's DIP-28_W15.24mm courtyard is drawn around a generic, shorter DIP-28 body.
